title: TOEIC® Listening - Versión 7: IT Infrastructure & Server Support
description: Prueba intensiva de comprensión auditiva TOEIC® enfocada en el contexto de Starlight Inc con the IT Director.

parts.visual:
## 📸 Simulación de Auditiva: Starlight Inc

Evaluaremos tu destreza auditiva en el contexto de **Starlight Inc** (Líder a cargo: **the IT Director**).

Concéntrate plenamente en las descripciones y los audios corporativos.
parts.audio: Welcome to this specialized TOEIC Listening drill. Listen closely to the speaker options and pick the best description of the workspace. Good luck!

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTOGRAPH]: Look at the business picture of Starlight Inc's office staff. Select the correct description.
questions.audio_script: A) They are installing routers in the server rack. B) They are replacing the computer monitors. C) The data center is empty. D) They are coding a mobile application.
questions.explanation: Se observa a los ingenieros de sistemas conectando el cableado estructurado en el rack de servidores.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the conversation and answer: What is the main issue discussed by the speakers?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi David, did you check the network upgrade plan from Starlight Inc?
W: Yes. The IT Director wants all cloud access permissions registered in CloudCRM by tonight.
M: Good. That will secure our databases before the system migration.
options: The contract pricing is too high.
The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
They want to cancel the shipment.
The company wants to buy ApexCRM.
questions.correct_answer: The delivery window is too narrow for their schedule.
questions.explanation: La mujer menciona explícitamente: 'pricing is competitive, but their delivery window is too narrow for our schedule'.
